parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Pour 40 cm 3 of cold water into the boiling tube. Record, in the first row of Table 4.1, the temperature θ C of the cold water.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Pour 300 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. Record, in the first row of the table, the temperature θ H of the hot water.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Lower the boiling tube into the beaker of hot water and immediately start the stopclock. Record, in the table, the temperature θ C of the cold water and the temperature θ H of the hot water at times t = 30 s, 60 s, 90 s, 120 s, 150 s and 180 s. parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Carefully pour away the water from the boiling tube and the beaker. Make sure that the boiling tube is secure in the clamp. Pour 20 cm 3 of cold water into the boiling tube. Record its temperature θ C in the table. Repeat steps (a)(ii) and (a)(iii) .
